# Transfer Learning: A Comprehensive Survey

**Authors:** Sinno Jialin Pan, Qiang Yang  
**Year:** 2010  
**Journal:** IEEE Transactions on Knowledge and Data Engineering  
**DOI:** [10.1109/TKDE.2009.191](https://doi.org/10.1109/TKDE.2009.191)  
**Publisher:** [https://www.cse.ust.hk/~qyang/Docs/2009/tkde_transfer_learning.pdf](https://www.cse.ust.hk/~qyang/Docs/2009/tkde_transfer_learning.pdf)

## Abstract

We present a comprehensive survey of transfer learning research and discuss the current state of the art and future research directions.
